completion_gate: Replay both arms on the grown holdings and verify a passing control and a failing control. State how preparations were generated, which physical records differ, and whether the result is sensitive to a quantum relative phase.
dependency_text: The prior calibration sets the two-preparation test. Its reproducible funded growth and earlier physical-memory controls establish the baseline.
objective: From a common start, test existing lawful growth and changes on a larger system for two generated preparations, identical declared ordinary marginals and opposite signs from one precommitted label-blind readout. Track the source of the difference and test equality of complete preparations separately.
status: Planned. Two ordinary event orders, original shared-mark parity read, held-out seven-knot and later-growth controls registered.
stop_rule: Finish when the declared native preparation and fixed-read comparison has an exact result, or an explicit obstruction under specified resources, with its strongest equal-state control.
title: Can ordinary knot growth generate two preparations with opposite fixed readouts?
